oracle.invariant: S1: every test passes, none skipped (among them: an ink palette band takes var(--ds-c-fg-2) as ground and var(--ds-c-bg) as its text). Each tch contract's id is <slug>/j6/<v>, built from tokenized stylesheets, with a template-profiles row. S3: each ready template at minVersion → {contract:'joomla-<slug>'}; the version before → reason TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE. S4: a one-colour linear-gradient is that fill ([0,113,227]); a two-colour one is a picture (null); a 2 x 32 px positioned ::before is no picture; a ::before picture covering the box is a picture; a positioned 2000 x 40 px ::before with an opaque fill is the text's ground ([26,68,68]); a 80 x 4 px ::after is not.
